ValidationRule.description: For Account Closure Record Type. When newly setting the Status to Closed, require Case Results, Closure Reason, and Save Tactic Used to be filled out.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = 'Account Closure', ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Closed")), OR( TEXT(Case_Results__c) = '', TEXT(Closure_Reason__c) = '', TEXT(Save_Tactic_Used__c) = '' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in the Case Results, Closure Reason, and Save Tactic Used fields before closing the Account Closure case
